The second equation represents the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining \(4+k\) and \(k+3i\), which simplifies to the line
\[
4x-3y=4k+\frac72.
\]
The first equation is the circle centered at \(25+20i\) with radius \(5\):
\[
(x-25)^2+(y-20)^2=25.
\]
For the system to have exactly one solution, the line must be tangent to the circle, so the distance from \((25,20)\) to the line equals \(5\):
\[
\frac{|4(25)-3(20)-(4k+\frac72)|}{5}=5.
\]

Thus
\[
\frac{73}{2}-4k=25 \quad \text{or} \quad \frac{73}{2}-4k=-25,
\]
giving
\[
k=\frac{23}{8} \quad \text{or} \quad k=\frac{123}{8}.
\]
Their sum is
\[
\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]
So \(m+n=73+4=77\).

ANSWER: 77
